Elaine (CSM): Heads up — NovusData renewal in 18 days and usage has dropped ~65% this quarter. Seeing only daily health-check prompts, no heavy inference jobs. :warning:
Sam P (PS): Ugh, ok. Have we captured the reason? adoption gap, cost, or stuck in eval?
Elaine (CSM): From last call: they said 'waiting on platform integration', but last two weeks there's been no repo activity. No support tickets either.
Miguel (Eng): I can pull model invocation logs and latency/cost trends. Might show if they switched to smaller batch sizes or throttled.
Devon (Onboarding): If it's integration friction we should offer a concise 'integration clinic' — 30m live session + a checklist. Low-effort for them, high signal for us.
Amar (AE): Potential risk of downgrade. Could consider a short 30% off month or free burst to re-run pipelines. But want CSM to confirm first.
churn-bot: AUTO: account NovusData flagged: "usage_drop_30d" + renewal_21d. Priority: high.
Elaine (CSM): Good. Proposal: 1) 30m integration clinic for infra team 2) targeted runbook for their engineers 3) a 2-week free burst credit if they commit to a re-run. Who can own the tech session?
Devon (Onboarding): I can run the clinic Tue or Thu this week. Will prepare a 1-page runbook with troubleshooting checklist.
Miguel (Eng): I’ll produce a short diagnostics pack: invocation histogram, error rates, average token sizes, and any sudden quantization/compat mismatch logs. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Sam P (PS): I'll craft a 3-slide value recap showing cost per token vs expected throughput; helps Amar with exec ask.
Amar (AE): I'll prep the commercial note. If they agree to a 2-week re-run we can offer the credit. I’ll own negotiation.
Elaine (CSM): Nice. Quick micro-play we can send now to the CSM cohort for this account (DM me edits):
Elaine (CSM): ```Checklist: - Book 30m clinic (Devon) - Share diagnostics pack (Miguel) - Send value recap + invite (Sam) - Offer 2-week credit + sign-off (Amar) - Schedule follow-up QBR in 21 days (Elaine)```
Elaine (CSM): Target outcomes: re-run ingest, confirm 3 key inference workflows, and convert to steady weekly cadence.
Sam P (PS): Suggest adding a short success metric we can hit: +30% weekly tokens within 14 days or we escalate to AE for commercial incentive.
Amar (AE): Agreed. Add clause: if no usage bump after credit, propose downgrade path options and timeline. Keep it transparent.
Devon (Onboarding): I’ll draft the calendar invite and one-pager. Sending first copy in this thread shortly.
Miguel (Eng): FYI found a spike in 04/02 error logs — likely cause of the slowdown, pushing details now.
Elaine (CSM): Sending outreach email draft: "Quick check — want to run a 30m clinic to unblock integration and offer a 2-week compute credit to re-run pipelines" — I'll post draft after Miguel's pack.
churn-bot: NOTE: previous save-play attempted 3 months ago; outcome = partial engagement. Recommend prioritizing hands-on session.
Elaine (CSM): K. Actions: Devon (book clinic by EOD), Miguel (diagnostics by EOD tomorrow), Sam (value slides by tomorrow), Amar (prepare credit terms). I’ll own the outreach and follow-up.
Amar (AE): 👍 will have credit template ready.

Amar (AE): I'll sync with their CFO in the outreach note post-clinic.
Elaine (CSM): Thanks team. If clinic goes well we push credit and schedule a short QBR 2 weeks after. If not, we'll open downgrade path conversation with clear checklist and timelines. :thumbsup:
